description: This file defines the Activity class for vtiger CRM, handling calendar activities such as meetings and tasks. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and managing related entities, reminders, recurring events, and accessibility control within the CRM system.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Represents calendar activities within vtiger CRM, managing CRUD operations, relationships, reminders, recurring events, access controls, and related data.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles module-specific save operations, including relation management, recurrence, reminders, and invitees.

methods.name: insertIntoActivityReminderPopup
methods.description: Inserts or updates activity reminder popup data.

methods.name: insertIntoReminderTable
methods.description: Creates or updates reminder entries for activities, based on user input.

methods.name: insertIntoRecurringTable
methods.description: Inserts recurring event data into vtiger_recurringevents.

methods.name: insertIntoInviteeTable
methods.description: Populates the invitees associated with an activity.

methods.name: insertIntoSmActivityRel
methods.description: Creates relationships between activities and users or invitees.

methods.name: getJoinClause
methods.description: Returns the join clause syntax for related tables.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order for activity listing.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves the field used for ordering activity listings.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Fetches contacts related to a specific activity.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Fetches users related to a specific activity.

methods.name: get_full_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of activities based on a criteria.

methods.name: getCount_Meeting
methods.description: Counts meetings associated with a user.

methods.name: get_calendars
methods.description: Fetches meetings for a user within a range.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Counts tasks associated with a user.

methods.name: get_tasks
methods.description: Fetches tasks for a user within a range.

methods.name: process_list_query1
methods.description: Processes and formats activity list query results.

methods.name: activity_reminder
methods.description: Creates, updates, or deletes activity reminder entries.

methods.name: get_tasksforol
methods.description: Gets task query for Outlook plugin integration.

methods.name: get_calendarsforol
methods.description: Gets calendar query for Outlook plugin.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Removes all dependencies related to an activity.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes specific relationship between activity and another entity.

methods.name: setActivityReminder
methods.description: Sets the activity's reminder status on or off.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates the secondary query part for reports.

methods.name: getNonAdminAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Returns access control query for non-admin users.

methods.name: setupTemporaryTable
methods.description: Prepares temporary tables for user access control.
